description: This file contains PHP unit tests for the ClaimDao class, specifically for testing claim request retrieval functionality within the Claim DAO component of the OrangeHRM system. It sets up test data, and includes test methods for fetching claim requests by ID and list filtering.

classes.name: ClaimDaoRequestTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test class for testing ClaimDao's methods related to claim request retrieval, including setup with test fixtures and specific test cases for fetching claim requests.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the test environment, including instantiating the ClaimDao object and populating test data fixtures.

methods.name: testGetClaimRequestById
methods.description: Tests retrieving a claim request by its ID and asserting that the retrieved ID matches the expected value.

methods.name: testGetClaimRequestList
methods.description: Tests retrieving a list of claim requests filtered by employee number and asserts the count of retrieved requests.
